beat: Risk, governance and accountability in autonomous systems
note: The vocabulary this publication classifies with. Inherited edges come from the fifteen published at graphs.sgit.ai/v1/grammar/edge-set.html and are used unchanged; proposed edges are new here and are marked as such. Every edge is a verb with a distinct, meaningfully-named inverse — no symmetric 'related' edge exists, by rule.

node_types.label: Body
node_types.definition: A regulator, supervisory authority, standards body or legislature that publishes binding or advisory text.

node_types.label: Instrument
node_types.definition: A regulation, directive, standard or other named body of text that can be cited as a whole.

node_types.label: Provision
node_types.definition: An article, clause or recital inside an instrument, addressable on its own.

node_types.label: Publication
node_types.definition: A dated artefact issued by a Body: guidance, a news item, a consultation, a decision, a consolidated text.

node_types.label: Fact
node_types.definition: An extracted claim about what a text says or when something happened. A Fact records the source it came from and its anchor state; anchoring pins it to a byte range in a frozen copy, and nothing in this release is anchored.

node_types.label: Question
node_types.definition: Something a text does not determine. A first-class node, not an omission — countable, dateable and assignable.

node_types.label: Role
node_types.definition: A duty-holder named by an instrument: provider, deployer, importer, authority.

node_types.label: Milestone
node_types.definition: A dated event in an instrument's life: adoption, entry into force, applicability, amendment.

edges.sentence: This fact is backed by that publication.
This fact gives rise to that question.
This fact is conditional on that one holding.
This fact was observed on that date.
This publication was published by that body.
This provision is part of that instrument.
This fact is anchored in that provision.
This provision leaves that question open.
This fact supersedes that earlier one, which is kept.
This instrument is dated by that milestone.

formulas.expression: Publication where a dates edge to its own Milestone precedes the in-force Milestone of the Instrument it claims to consolidate
formulas.note: Classification is a queryable formula rather than a label somebody applied. Change the formula and every affected publication reclassifies at once — which is itself a correction and is published as one.

formulas.expression: Provision that obliges a Role and also leaves_open at least one Question
formulas.note: A duty exists and what satisfies it is undetermined. This is the class of finding the absence report exists to surface.

banned.why: Symmetric edges carry no direction and no meaning. Banned by the inherited grammar and checked by the gate.
Too weak to be worth an edge: it says a string appeared, not that anything follows from it.
